subject: Cypress Health private hosting qualification & procurement pathway
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@cypresshealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: private hosting discovery — high level asks and blockers

Hi Alice — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call so we have a single source of truth and clear next steps. Please correct me if I misstate anything.

Summary of pain / goals you shared:
- Primary requirement: run all inference in a customer-controlled VPC/on-prem environment with no outbound internet egress from the inference hosts.
- Data residency: PHI must remain in your US East (Virginia) region and be retained per your policies; logs/audit trails must be exportable to your SIEM.
- Air-gap / regulatory driver: your compliance team prefers an isolated deployment (no external package pull at run-time) and a runbook for patching that can be scheduled with your ops team.
- Key management: want to use your AWS KMS/HSM keys; Redwood keys must not be used for primary data encryption.
- Ops constraints: limited inbound ports (443 only to a customer-approved proxy), strict egress rules, and no ability for outbound DNS resolution from the model hosts.

Next steps we agreed on:
1) I’ll send a short technical checklist you can share with your networking team (I’ve attached a starter sketch).
2) You’ll introduce your IT Security lead (cc’d here) and Procurement to get an NDA + procurement timeline in motion.
3) Ben will scope a preliminary SOW and estimate for an isolated/private deployment (including optional on-prem installation).
4) Laura will pull our SOC2 summary and notes about KMS integrations and provide them by end of week.

Open questions we need to close to proceed:
- Do you require a fully air-gapped image push (sneakernet) or can we stage images via an approved bastion/proxy?
- What is your expected go-live window (quarter target)?
- Are there any third-party network appliances (F5, Palo Alto) that the deployment must integrate with?

Attachments: cypress-network-sketch.pdf (sketch, 120KB) — quick placeholder for ports/trust zones.

If that matches, I’ll aim to have the SOC2 summary and SOW stub over by Friday. Thanks,

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.ai] | +1 415 555 0142
From: Alice Monroe <alice@cypresshealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: IT Security <it-sec@cypresshealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@cypresshealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: private hosting discovery — high level asks and blockers

Jordan — this is a very accurate recap, thank you. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Air-gap approach: our security team would prefer images and code pushed via an approved staging server (no direct pull from public registries). We can support a bastion that has tightly controlled egress to a staging S3 bucket you provide.
- Ports: we can open 443 to your monitoring endpoint but all other outbound must be blocked. DNS resolution will be allowed only via our internal resolver (we will provide IPs).
- KMS: we will provide a key policy and a service principal for Redwood to use for encrypting model weights and persisted artifacts; Redwood should demonstrate you can operate with customer-managed keys during a POC.
- Timeline: our target is a late Q3 pilot with ramp in Q4, but procurement wants a clear cost estimate and SOW this quarter.

I’m adding IT Security (Tim) and Procurement (Mina) to the thread — they’ll have additional questions about logging cadence and retention.

Best,
Alice
VP Product, Cypress Health
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Monroe <alice@cypresshealth.com>, IT Security <it-sec@cypresshealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@cypresshealth.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: private hosting discovery — high level asks and blockers

Looping in for SOW/estimate. Notes from my side after the call: 

- High level plan: 1) POC (2-4 weeks) — private deployment in your VPC with a small model and controlled traffic; 2) Pilot (6-8 weeks) — expand to production-sized model and integrate with KMS and SIEM; 3) GA/rollout.
- Estimated baseline (very rough): engineering + deployment + 3 months support for POC ≈ $65k — depends heavily on whether we need an air-gapped image transfer vs staged S3 with bastion. If fully air-gapped with physical media we’ll add a logistics fee.
- Risk notes: no DNS + no egress will require us to package all runtime dependencies and confirm the runtime can resolve required cert revocation lists locally (we may need to embed CRLs into the image).
- Deliverables we’ll include: runbook for patching, documented KMS integration steps, audit-log forwarding config for your SIEM, and a simple rollback plan.

Action items I’ll own this week:
- Draft SOW + line-item estimate and upload to the deal link.
- Provide a quick checklist for a bastion-led staging flow vs. physical media flow.

Ben Carter
Director, Solutions Architecture, Redwood Inference
[ben_carter@redwood.ai] | +1 650 555 0217
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@cypresshealth.com>, IT Security <it-sec@cypresshealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@cypresshealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: private hosting discovery — high level asks and blockers

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached are: 1) our SOC2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf), 2) an editable SOW estimate stub (estimated-sow-CYP-2027-045.xlsx), and 3) an updated sketch focused on bastion-led staging (cypress-network-sketch.pdf). 

Immediate asks from Cypress to keep momentum: 
- IT Security: can you confirm if the bastion → staging S3 pattern is acceptable or if procurement requires physical media? If bastion is OK, please provide IP allowlist and internal DNS server IPs.
- Procurement: can you share any specific PO/legal templates we should slot our SOW into?
- Ops: please confirm your preferred window for a locked-down patch cadence (e.g., monthly maintenance window) and retention policy for audit logs (we support 90/180/365 day options).

Planned next checkpoint: I’ll update the deal page with the SOW link once Ben finishes the line items (target EOD Friday). If we can get a security decision on bastion vs physical media this week we can scope out the logistics fee and provide a firm estimate.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf, 210KB); estimated-sow-CYP-2027-045.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB); cypress-network-sketch.pdf (pdf, 85KB)
